source: Quiz 5 - Sessions 1-6: Model Training, Alignment, and the Agent Harness
question: Which statement best explains why an agent's usefulness depends on the whole system?

options.text: The model's language ability determines whether file actions are available
options.feedback: A capable model can propose useful actions, but the surrounding system must provide tools and access to carry them out.

options.text: The model, tools, and guidance work within the harness
options.feedback: The lecture describes capability as a property of the parts working together. The surrounding environment affects what the model can accomplish.

options.text: A detailed skill supplies both a procedure and the access it requires
options.feedback: A skill supplies guidance. Tools and permissions must also exist for its steps to execute.

options.text: A connector supplies both service access and the complete task procedure
options.feedback: A connector exposes an integration. The instructions for using it toward your goal are a separate part of the system.
